// diagnostic E0225

Jet.UnusedPlaceMark

This mark does not match a named argument that the call changes or takes, or sits on a receiver, fresh value, copied type, function item, or unmovable part.

What

This mark does not match a named argument that the call changes or takes, or sits on a receiver, fresh value, copied type, function item, or unmovable part.

Why

A call writes `^` before a named argument it changes (`grow(^xs)`) and may write `^^` before a whole non-copy name it takes (`seal(^^buf)`). Method receivers stay unmarked (`xs.push(4)`), read arguments, fresh values, copied types, and function items take no mark, a field moves with `owner.field.move()`, and a collection element stays owned by its collection.

Fix

Remove the mark, or write `.move()` on a movable field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnusedPlaceMark: Tests/UI/call_mark_outside_writes_policy.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnusedPlaceMark: Method receivers are never marked in Jet, so remove `^` before `xs`
  --> Tests/UI/call_mark_outside_writes_policy.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     ^xs.push(5)
    |     ^
 Why: `push: fn(^self, ^^Int)` changes its receiver, and Jet marks only changed arguments (`f(^x)`), never method receivers (`x.m()`)
 Fix: Remove the `^`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UnusedPlaceMark
